title: Sub Jail Sub Jails are the smaller institutions situated at sub-divisional level in the States. Interestingly, States/UTs from where the data on Prisons for the year 1999 was made available, 8 states viz. Andhra Pradesh (118), Tamil Nadu (114), Madhya Pradesh (86), Karnataka (79), Rajasthan (59), Orissa (51), Bihar (43), Kerala (32) and West Bengal (31) reported comparatively higher number of such jails in their States which indicates a well organised prison set-up even at lower formation. Bihar had the highest capacity of inmates (5620) in various Sub-Jails. This was followed by the States of Mahdya Pradesh (5605), Tamil Nadu (3933), Rajasthan (3408), Andhra Pradesh (3093), Orissa (2870), Karnataka (2397), West Bengal (1848) and Kerala
